findings.evidence: A store with no change event needs an observation mechanism first: write an adapter that notifies subscribers, for example one `setInterval` poll (choose the interval; clear it when the last subscriber leaves)
findings.fix: Give a default interval (1000ms) and the unsubscribe rule (clear the interval when the subscriber count hits zero) instead of 'choose the interval', and keep the fallback that a store with no observation mechanism is read once on mount and can go stale.
